title: Error
description: Every refusal of the Manubrium API (any 4xx, and 503 engine_busy): `error` is the code the app matches on, `message` a sentence shown as it is. Some refusals add fields: `confirm` (+ `summary`, `warnings` or `checker`) on 409 needs_acknowledgement, `current` on 409 conflict.

error.description: The machine-readable code, e.g. tournament_not_found, arbiter_role, needs_acknowledgement, conflict, unauthorized, rate_limited, bad_request.

confirm.description: 409 needs_acknowledgement: the ids to send back in `acknowledged`. Not sent by POST /rounds (pairing), whose questions arrive in the tournament's next_round.warnings instead.

summary.description: Hand edit: what the edit does, as the desk's dialog says it.

warnings.description: Hand edit: the pairing rules the new boards break.

checker.description: Finishing hand edits: the pairing checker's verdict.

line.description: The PIBE line that would be recorded.

current.description: 409 conflict: what the board says now ("" for no result).
